about.title: About Me
about.p1: I graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems from Telkom University Jakarta with a GPA of 3.64/4.00.
about.p2: During my studies I applied theory into practice. As a Teaching Assistant across 4 courses I gained experience from system modeling (UML, BPMN, AHP) to backend implementation (Laravel, MySQL).
about.p3: During an internship at PT Telkom Akses, I designed and developed an internal e-procurement system that streamlined procurement processes.
about.conclusion: I'm ready to contribute as a System Analyst or Backend Developer with a focus on code quality, clear documentation, and user-centric solutions.
